title: The Tortoise and the Eagle
summary: A little creature longs to fly and begs a powerful bird for a chance.
coverScene: A small turtle looks up with excitement at a large eagle flying high above the green land.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, a small animal had a big wish to fly up.
He spent every day watching birds high above the green hills and town houses.
The small animal felt that life on the ground was too slow for him.
He had always wanted to see the world from high above.
One afternoon, a strong bird landed near the small animal on the ground.
The small animal asked the big bird for help with his secret wish.
The big bird explained that animals of his kind were not made for flying.
However, the small animal would not listen to any good advice from his friend.
The big bird agreed to try and took the small animal up.
They flew high above the tall trees and the small town houses.
The small animal felt glad as the wind blew around him in the air.
He forgot that his heavy body could not support him up in the open sky.
He started to shout with extreme happiness, believing he was a bird like the others.
Suddenly, the big bird let go because the small animal moved too much.
The small animal began to fall fast toward the hard ground below.
He realized his mistake too late before a heavy crash against a large stone.
From that day on, the small animal never wanted to fly again in his life.
He has stayed on the ground and walked slowly through the green plants.
The experience has taught him that every living thing has its proper place in the world.
Many days have passed since that terrible accident happened in the open field near the town.
If the small animal tried to fly again, he would surely fall down.
Therefore, he always stays close to the safe earth and walks slowly every day.
He has learned that life on the ground is the best place for him to live.
Other animals in the area have seen what happened to him during that strange flight.
They also know that flying is only for birds in the sky.
If anyone asks the small animal about his trip, he just smiles and shakes his head.
He has never forgotten the lessons of that afternoon when he tried to reach high.
The world is full of wonderful things to see.
He does not need to leave the safety of the green trees.
Every animal must accept his own natural limits and be glad with what he has.
He will never go up into the open sky again.
The ground is his home and he will stay there for the rest of his life.
Life is good when you walk on the green earth and look at the trees.
He knows that the ground is the right place for an animal like him.
That is his story and he will always remember it well.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, there lived a little creature who had a great desire to fly.
He spent every day watching birds high up in the blue sky, wishing that he could join them.
The animal felt that his life on the ground was too slow and boring.
He wanted to see the world from above, just like the large birds did.
One afternoon, a strong bird flew down and landed near the creature.
The animal went to the big creature and asked for help.
He explained his deep wish to fly across the clouds and see distant places.
The bird looked at him with surprise and tried to explain that animals were not made for flying.
However, the creature would not listen to any reason or good advice.
He asked the bird again and again until the creature finally agreed to try.
If the animal had known the danger, he would have stayed down.
If the bird had not helped him, he would not have fallen.
If the creature were smarter, he would always walk on the ground.
The bird, who was very wise, watched the animal from a tall tree.
The bird picked up the animal with his strong feet and began to rise into the air.
They flew high above the trees, the green hills, and the small houses of the town.
The creature felt an amazing sense of happiness as the wind blew around him.
He looked down at the earth and thought that he was the most successful animal alive.
He forgot that he had no wings of his own and that his heavy shell could not support him in the sky.
He started to shout with joy, believing that he was now a bird.
Suddenly, the bird let go of him because the silly creature was moving too much.
The animal began to fall fast through the open air, heading straight down toward the hard ground.
He realized his big mistake too late, wishing that he had stayed safe on the earth.
With a loud crash, the poor creature landed on a large stone, learning a very hard lesson about desire and reality.
People in the nearby town often talk about the day the animal tried to fly.
This story remains an important lesson for anyone who wishes for impossible things.
From that day on, the animal never wanted to fly again.
He stayed on the ground where he belonged and walked slowly through the grass.
The experience taught him that every creature has its own proper place in the world.
He understood that wishing for things beyond one natural ability only brings trouble.
The animal walked through the green grass every morning.
He thought about the flight that had caused him so much pain.
The big bird watched him from high above in the branches.
The creature knew that he must never leave the ground again.
His heavy shell was meant for walking, not for flying through the clouds.
Other animals looked at him and understood the lesson.
Life on the earth was good enough for everyone who lived there.
The story of the foolish flight was told by the villagers for many years.
